tools_helpful.evidence: session-log.txt:5238-5242 — native build surfaced the CS0118 errors and confirmed BUILD_EXIT=0 after the fix.

tools_problematic.problem: A too-greedy regex ('\bDatagramSocket\b(?!Sample|MessageReceived|WinRT|Socket)') corrupted the alias definition itself, rewriting 'using WinDatagramSocket = Windows.Networking.Sockets.DatagramSocket;' into '...Sockets.WinDatagramSocket;', requiring a second cleanup pass.

special_apis.special_handling: Its short type name is identical to the project RootNamespace/AssemblyName (DatagramSocket), so unqualified uses in code resolve to the namespace, not the type → CS0118. Must be fully-qualified or aliased.

errors_encountered.error: CS0118: 'DatagramSocket' is a namespace but is used like a type (Scenario1_Start.xaml.cs:182, Scenario2_Connect.xaml.cs:131, Scenario5_MulticastAndBroadcast.xaml.cs:34,253)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Project RootNamespace is 'DatagramSocket' (session-log.txt:1944, the scaffold names it after the UWP sample), which shadows the same-named WinRT type Windows.Networking.Sockets.DatagramSocket. C# resolves the bare identifier to the in-scope namespace.
errors_encountered.fix: Alias the WinRT type once per file ('using WinDatagramSocket = Windows.Networking.Sockets.DatagramSocket;') or fully-qualify each usage; then replace the bare-type declarations/instantiations with the alias.

errors_encountered.error: XamlCompiler WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' + WMC1509 'No LocalAssembly parameter during MarkupCompilePass2' + WMC1111 (MainPage.xaml:40-41)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Cascade from the CS0118 failure: when MarkupCompilePass1/C# compile fails, the XAML compiler cannot resolve project-local types, producing these secondary errors. Not an independent defect.
errors_encountered.fix: Resolving the CS0118 collision cleared all of these; the final build had 0 errors (session-log.txt:5057).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: 7-error build (4x CS0118 + 3 cascading XAML errors) that looked like two unrelated problems (namespace collision + a XAML DataType error).
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: 2 build cycles (first regex fix corrupted the alias line, second pass fixed it, then a clean build).
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: No skill guidance existed for project-name/WinRT-type collision; the agent had to diagnose CS0118 from scratch and hand-roll a bulk regex, which mangled its own alias.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Added a per-file type alias and replaced bare-type usages; rebuilt clean.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A documented 'CS0118 — RootNamespace collides with a same-named WinRT type' pattern in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Common build errors' with the alias/fully-qualify fix and a note that same-named XAML DataType errors are a downstream cascade.
